```artifact
Feature: Manage Doctor Details
  As a system,
  I want to manage doctor details,
  So that I can maintain accurate information about doctors.

  Scenario: Add a new unique Doctor
    Given there is no doctor with the name "Dr. John Doe"
    When I add a new doctor with name "Dr. John Doe", age 45, sex "Male", qualification "MBBS", experience 10, and speciality "Cardiology"
    Then the doctor "Dr. John Doe" should be added with age 45, sex "Male", qualification "MBBS", experience 10, and speciality "Cardiology"

  Scenario Outline: View and Update the details of an existing Doctor
    Given there is a doctor with name "<name>", age <age>, sex "<sex>", qualification "<qualification>", experience <experience>, and speciality "<speciality>"
    When I update the doctor's details with name "<new_name>", age <new_age>, sex "<new_sex>", qualification "<new_qualification>", experience <new_experience>, and speciality "<new_speciality>"
    Then the doctor's details should be updated to name "<new_name>", age <new_age>, sex "<new_sex>", qualification "<new_qualification>", experience <new_experience>, and speciality "<speciality>"
    Examples:
      | name         | age | sex  | qualification | experience | speciality  | new_name       | new_age | new_sex | new_qualification | new_experience | new_speciality |
      | Dr. John Doe | 45  | Male | MBBS          | 10         | Cardiology  | Dr. John Doe   | 46    | Male  | MBBS              | 11             | Cardiology     |
      | Dr. Jane Doe | 35  | Female | MD          | 8          | Neurology   | Dr. Jane Smith | 36    | Female| MD                | 9              | Neurology      |

  Scenario: Delete the Doctor Details with no pending Patient Consultation Request
    Given there is a doctor with name "Dr. John Doe" and no pending patient consultation requests
    When I delete the doctor "Dr. John Doe"
    Then the doctor "Dr. John Doe" should be deleted

  Scenario: Attempt to delete the Doctor Details with pending Patient Consultation Request
    Given there is a doctor with name "Dr. John Doe" and a pending patient consultation request
    When I delete the doctor "Dr. John Doe"
    Then the system should not delete the doctor "Dr. John Doe" and should display an error message "Cannot delete doctor with pending consultation requests"

Feature: Manage Chemist & Labs Details
  As a system,
  I want to manage chemist and lab details,
  So that I can maintain accurate information about chemists and labs.

  Scenario: Add a new Chemist or Lab
    Given there is no chemist or lab in pincode "123456"
    When I add a new chemist with name "Chemist XYZ", pincode "123456", and address "123, Main St"
    Then the chemist "Chemist XYZ" should be added with pincode "123456" and address "123, Main St"

  Scenario Outline: View and Update the details of an existing Chemist/Lab
    Given there is a chemist with name "<name>", pincode "<pincode>", and address "<address>"
    When I update the chemist's details with name "<new_name>", pincode "<new_pincode>", and address "<new_address>"
    Then the chemist's details should be updated to name "<new_name>", pincode "<pincode>", and address "<new_address>"
    Examples:
      | name        | pincode | address       | new_name      | new_pincode | new_address     |
      | Chemist XYZ | 123456  | 123, Main St  | Chemist ABC   | 123456      | 456, Main St    |
      | Lab ABC     | 654321  | 789, Lab St   | Lab XYZ       | 654321      | 987, Lab St     |

  Scenario: Delete the Chemist/Lab Details with no pending Prescription
    Given there is a chemist with name "Chemist XYZ" and no pending prescriptions
    When I delete the chemist "Chemist XYZ"
    Then the chemist "Chemist XYZ" should be deleted

  Scenario: Attempt to delete the Chemist/Lab Details with pending Prescription
    Given there is a chemist with name "Chemist XYZ" and a pending prescription
    When I delete the chemist "Chemist XYZ"
    Then the system should not delete the chemist "Chemist XYZ" and should display an error message "Cannot delete chemist with pending prescriptions"
```
